classification_policy.overlap: Categories are independent attributes; each array may contain multiple exact labels. Arrays are not mutually exclusive and totals do not sum to camera count.
classification_policy.Point and Shoot: Consumer fixed-lens snapshot workflow with fixed or automatic focus and simple fixed/automatic exposure. Includes disposables, simple instant snapshots, and fixed-focus snapshot box cameras. Does not automatically include every AE/AF SLR, manually focused rangefinder, or focusing TLR.
classification_policy.SLR: Real single-lens reflex optical construction, including DSLR and medium-format SLR. Excludes TLR, mirrorless and camcorders.
classification_policy.Rangefinder: A real coupled optical rangefinder used to focus. Excludes simple optical framing finders, sonar AF and rangefinder-styled mirrorless bodies.
classification_policy.Medium Format: Conventional medium-format roll-film/system shopping class (e.g. 120/220/620, 6x4.5 through 6x9). Neither 127 spool identity alone nor the physical area of integral instant film establishes this shopping class. The miniature 3x4 cm Vollenda is not automatically medium format.
classification_policy.Compact Camera: A positive body-form judgment: pocketable miniature cameras, normal small snapshot compacts, genuinely small rangefinders and documented small compact-system bodies. Not a synonym for fixed-lens, folding, mirrorless or lightweight relative to a large format. M50 II and E-PL2 included; larger X-Pro1 and Pony bodies conservatively withheld. No universal industry size cutoff is implied.
classification_policy.Large Format: Large image format including old large roll-film cameras; not restricted to contemporary sheet-film loading. No.4A qualifies by 4.25x6.5 inch frame.
classification_policy.TLR: Construction is recorded in camera_kind/evidence only. TLR is not added to the six allowed labels.
classification_policy.instant_boundary: Integral instant cameras do not acquire Medium Format just because the image area overlaps medium-format negative sizes. TL70 remains outside these six under this explicit shopping policy.
classification_policy.empty_arrays: Noncamera accessories and real cameras outside the six both have empty arrays. Always consult is_camera/classification_status to distinguish them.
classification_policy.condition: Sold-out, body-only, broken, display and repair camera listings remain cameras and retain construction/format labels.
